bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT\n'
R=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-32de51235279b64bfa5abb35efb0ec5d31f1c3bf
printf 'DEPLOY_ROOT_PRESENT='; test -d "$R" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'DEPLOY_COMPOSE_PRESENT='; test -f "$R/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'DEPLOY_ENV_PRESENT='; test -f "$R/deploy/.env" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'DEPLOY_OWNER_ADAPTER_PRESENT='; test -f "$R/owner/gateOwner.mjs" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'DEPLOY_IMAGE_PRESENT='; docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo no
printf 'BOT_API_EXECUTABLE='; command -v telegram-bot-api || true
printf 'LOCAL_API_RUNNING_COUNT='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'telegram-bot-api|local-bot-api' || true
printf 'TERMS_HTTP='
curl -L -sS -o /tmp/cv-terms-check-$$.html -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 25 https://tgtumbler-docs.pages.dev/createvdobot-terms.html
printf '\n'
T=/tmp/cv-terms-check-$$.html
for x in '投稿者の自己責任' '規約バージョン：1.0' '70％を投稿者' '30％を運営管理費'; do if grep -Fq "$x" "$T"; then echo 'TERMS_SECTION_PASS'; else echo 'TERMS_SECTION_MISSING'; fi; done
rm -f "$T"
